description: This file defines the TimestampValueValidator class, which is responsible for validating timestamp values by parsing CharSequence inputs into OffsetDateTime objects and throwing an exception if parsing fails.

classes.name: TimestampValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class tasked with validating timestamp header values by parsing them into OffsetDateTime objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TimestampValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the timestamp header value by attempting to parse it into an OffsetDateTime; throws an exception if parsing fails.
